integration_scope: Owner-reviewed AgentMemory and Browser Use operations; exact action approval and task access with owner-selected duration including until revoked; explicit task selection and revocation; adaptive voice endpoint and early eligible spoken replies.
source_commit_resolution: Build receipt binds final commit and all payload files; this source metadata does not assert approval, signature or activation.
exclusion_reason: Unchanged host-specific legacy scripts remain only in trusted signed baseline runtime.
acceptance_limits: Firecrawl is an external service. Limited keyless access is the default; an optional host-configured API key may consume its plan.
Document converters are bundled for the existing portable Windows x64 Python 3.12 runtime. No local document upload to cloud services.
PDF text and modern DOCX/PPTX/XLSX only, plus retained TXT/Markdown/CSV. No OCR, old binary Office formats or macro execution.
Owner authority, versioned history and personal memory are preserved. Moving the installed package to another computer is not physically tested in this update.

Model-generated updates change one existing bounded implementation file. Larger files, multiple-file changes, tests, dependencies and approval/signing/policy code require a separate development update.
Self-improvement activation requires this host's configured signing identity and fixed tested tools. These host credentials are not placed on the SSD; another host must configure its own tools.
Regression execution uses isolated test directories and process guards with the host user permissions. It is not an OS sandbox for hostile generated code.
Verified core restoration prepares an owner-approved host candidate from a matching signed recovery. It does not autonomously detect faults, activate recovery or move live files.

Silero acoustic turn ending waits about 0.8 seconds after established speech, 1.2 after tentative speech, and can adapt later pauses up to 1.6 seconds after observed hesitation. This is not semantic turn prediction or playback barge-in.

Eligible plain chat can speak a stable partial answer before final acceptance. Retry, cancellation or a final mismatch stops obsolete audio; already heard words cannot be recalled. Structured/code/evidence replies retain complete-answer speech. Microphone restarts only after final acceptance and playback completion.
AgentMemory 0.9.30 standalone uses isolated project JSON stores and keyword matching. No embedding engine, automatic capture hooks, server or provider account is enabled.

Browser Use 0.13.11 runs public HTTPS read/extraction in an owned temporary Chromium profile, with selected-host GET requests. Cross-host assets, redirects, account flows and arbitrary agent actions are not qualified.

A task grant permits only its reviewed task and envelope. Until-revoked grants persist on the issuing host; owner, host or application-policy changes require fresh review. Selecting an existing task for a conversation resumes it without new approval.
Task grants and owner credentials stay host-local. Resource bundles and project memories use SSD-relative paths. Native Windows runtime qualification does not establish physical Ubuntu compatibility.
Other catalogue entries retain their individually documented setup or reference status. No unverified leaked credentials or breach-record collection was installed.
Dev19 physical voice functionality was confirmed by the owner; dev20 audible speed and pause comfort need a new physical acceptance check.
